question: Who among the following has been appointed as 26th Chief Election Commissioner of India in February 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Gyanesh Kumar**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Gyanesh Kumar** was appointed as the **26th Chief Election Commissioner of India** in February 2025.
 
• He succeeded **Rajiv Kumar**, who served as the 25th Chief Election Commissioner.
 
• The Chief Election Commissioner is responsible for ensuring **free and fair elections** in India, including parliamentary, state assembly, and presidential elections.
 
• Gyanesh Kumar is an experienced IAS officer with a career spanning decades in public administration and governance.
 
• The Election Commission of India is a **constitutional body** established under Article 324 of the Indian Constitution to oversee the election process in the country.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Election Commission of India (ECI):**

 
 
• The ECI is an autonomous constitutional authority responsible for administering elections in India.
 
• It was established on **25th January 1950**, and this day is celebrated as National Voters' Day in India.
 
• The commission consists of the Chief Election Commissioner and two Election Commissioners.
 
 
 
• **Chief Election Commissioner (CEC):**
 
 
• The CEC is appointed by the President of India and has a tenure of **6 years or up to the age of 65 years**, whichever is earlier.
 
• The CEC can only be removed through **impeachment by Parliament**, similar to the process for removing a Supreme Court judge.
 
 
 
• **Role of the Election Commission:**
 
 
• Conducts elections to the Lok Sabha, Rajya Sabha, and State Legislatures.
 
• Oversees elections for the offices of the President and Vice-President of India.
 
• Ensures implementation of the Model Code of Conduct during elections.
 
• Regulates political parties and monitors their expenditure.
 
 
 
• **Recent Electoral Reforms:**
 
 
• Introduction of Voter Verifiable Paper Audit Trail (VVPAT) for transparency in elections.
 
• Linking of Aadhaar with voter IDs to eliminate duplicate entries in the electoral roll.
 
• Extension of postal ballot facilities to senior citizens and Persons with Disabilities (PwDs).
